idea-plugin.name: Forge Studio
idea-plugin.description:
Forge Studio inside your JetBrains IDE: a local workspace for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex and others) with chat, plan and agent modes, approvals, Git, previews and Android/Flutter tooling.

  • Forge Studio tool window – the full app, already focused on the open project.
  • Ask / Explain / Fix / Write Tests – send the selection or file from the editor (right-click → Forge Studio). Forge fills its message box with the code and the file/line reference so you can add details before sending.
  • IDE tools for the agent – with the IDE's MCP server on (Settings | Tools | MCP Server, 2025.2+), Forge Studio gives Claude Code the IDE's refactorings, inspections and run configurations.

Needs Forge Studio installed on this computer. Everything stays local: the plugin only talks to 127.0.0.1.
